description: Opt-in JSON response redaction: return only explicit JSON Pointer paths, e.g. /id and /items/*/name. * matches one segment; selecting a container allows its whole subtree. Applies to every upstream response for this app, including errors. Maximum 1 MiB and 5 seconds to read; invalid/non-JSON responses are withheld. No bodies are stored. A withheld reply never reverses an upstream write. null disables filtering. Free and Pro.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...
